about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Software Engineer focused on building efficient, scalable systems. My career is driven by delivering clean code, solid architectural patterns, and user-centric interfaces.
about.p2: Operating as a <1>Full Stack</1> developer, I navigate the complete development ecosystem—from crafting intuitive front-end interfaces to architecting backend endpoints and data persistence.
about.p3: I continuously strive for excellence in software engineering best practices, continuous integration, and modern design patterns.
